column6: City worthy of the divine powers, according to its name: shrine @wSN{Urim}, raging storm of @wGN{Sumer}, battleground -- and well established! Origin of human seed, consolidating the foundations of the Land, abundance -- and well established! Lofty dais of @wDN{An}, pure place, holy place, provider of first-fruit offerings for @wDN{An} to refresh himself, dripping with syrup and wine -- and well established! @wTN{Du-ur}, celebrated place of @wDN{Enlil}, in whose interior are the assigned divine powers, place whose destiny was decreed by Father @wDN{Enlil}, great dais -- and well established! @wSN{Eridug}, shrine expert in decreeing the fates, with princely divine powers, pure divine powers -- and well established! @wTN{E-kiš-nu-ŋal}, cattle-pen of @wDN{Suen}, where fecund cows, breed-bulls and holy calves gambol together, producing fine cream -- and well established! @fsux{Abzu}, holy residence of youthful @wDN{Suen}, tall crook lifting its head towards heaven, a marvel -- and well established!

@fsux{Ŋipar}, shrine built in exuberance, with the true divine powers of the rank of @fsux{en} priestess -- and well established! Princely @fsux{en} priestess, your great name is pure; loosener of the headdress of @wDN{Nanna} who makes the dwelling pleasant, with good words and justice -- and well established! @wWN{Id-nun-kug} @noteref{Holy princely river} with ample flowing waters, your reservoir abounds with fish and birds -- and well established! Its city, established within the encircling walls, is a battle-mace, a weapon -- and well established! The convened assembly of its numerous people is a shield -- and well established! Great awe of the occupied settlements of @wGN{Sumer} -- and well established! Its foreign lands, teeming like herds of fecund cows, fat cows, numerous ewes with their lambs in the sheepfold -- and well established! Its army, rising to battle, is an irresistible onrush of water, a fearsome sea, a raging …… -- and well established!

On the day when the destiny of the Land was determined, when the seed of all living beings was originally brought forth, when the king appeared radiantly to his comrade -- on that day, @wDN{Gilgameš}, the lord of @wSN{Kulaba}, conversed with @wRN{Šulgi}, the good shepherd of @wGN{Sumer}, at his shining feet. So that their praise would be sung forever, so that it be would handed down to distant days, so that it should be not forgotten in remote years, they looked at each other favourably in their mighty heroism.
